Chapter 676 - 676 Strength; Crisis!

Chapter 676 - 676 Strength; Crisis!

676 Strength; Crisis!

One had to know…

Xia Xue and Xia Bing now had extraordinary power.

However, just the aftermath of the battle was difficult for the two of them to resist.

The strength of Lin Fan and Black was evident.

The red, green, blue, gray, and purple shadows in the air only watched from afar. They did not speak or interfere.

Clearly, they wanted to see how strong Lin Fan was right now and if he was worthy of them giving him their power.

The first attack had failed.

In the darkness, countless black spears shot out once again. Like a rain of arrows, they shot toward Lin Fan.

The spears collided with the golden light on Lin Fan’s body. The loud sound continued, but it did not cause any damage to Lin Fan at all.

Seeing this…

The huge black shadow formed a huge claw and slapped at Lin Fan.

At this moment, the golden glow on Lin Fan’s body also formed a huge claw.

One black and one gold, the two claws collided in the air. They erupted with terrifying power. The wind whistled, and the space cracked and collapsed. It was extremely terrifying.

Both sides were equally strong.

At this moment, the golden glow around Lin Fan’s body suddenly condensed into a golden claw.

The golden claw swung fiercely, tearing the black claw in front of it into pieces.

Then, Lin Fan said casually, “My turn.”

In an instant…

The golden arrow rain that filled the sky shot out crazily.

All of them disappeared into the endless darkness.

The giant shadow in the darkness seemed to have the power to devour everything.

It was deep and vast.

But soon, a dash of gold appeared on the surface of the giant shadow in the darkness.

“What?”

In the darkness, a shocked voice came.

The golden arrow rain did not stop.

On the contrary, it became even more violent.

In the next moment…

Lin Fan raised his hand.

Boundless golden light suddenly condensed and turned into a huge golden sword that soared into the sky.

“Slash!”

The golden longsword swept with the power to destroy the world as it descended.

There was no sound.

The entire world seemed to have been muted.

At this moment…

Space and time completely stopped.

Only a golden longsword slowly descended.

The giant black shadow split into two, and a dazzling golden light spread out from the two halves.

Following that, extremely violent astral winds surged wantonly.

They almost sent Xia Xue and Xia Bing flying.

After a long time, the strong winds gradually stopped.

“What do you think?” Lin Fan said calmly.

The giant black shadow that had been split into two slightly wiggled its huge body.

“You won,” he said sadly.

The giant red shadow in the air said to itself, “Looking back on those days, Black liked to attack, Green liked to defend, Gray liked to destroy, Purple liked to charm, and I liked to create. Chaos Dragon God, you like treasures and sleep. It’s not bad for us to do what we like to do.

“Who knew that cracks would appear in the world and it could shatter at any time?

“Therefore, all of us tried to repair the world. However, after tens of thousands of years, we couldn’t do anything.

“Later on, we accidentally discovered the World-Core. We even discovered that our powers all came from the World-Core. As long as all the energies were combined, we could repair the world.

“Unfortunately, no matter what, we couldn’t get close to it, let alone devour it.

“After that, Green and I speculated that only by reincarnating as a new human would it be possible to devour it.

“Because humanity can be said to be completely nurtured by the World-Core. Humans are its children.

“The few of us hesitated and didn’t dare to take the risk.

“However, you, Chaos Dragon God, found it too boring and wanted to experience the life of a human being. Therefore, you chose to descend into the world.

“At first, we didn’t pay much attention to this matter because you, Chaos Dragon God, like to indulge yourself.

“You even created a system so that you’d have endless wealth as a new human…”

The giant red figure’s voice paused for a moment, as if it had fallen into some kind of memory.

After a while, he continued, “But who would have thought that you would come into contact with the World-Core in just 20 years?

“Then, in a mere thousand years, you completely fused with it.

“Chaos God Dragon…”

At this moment, Lin Fan, who had been silent all this while, suddenly interrupted, “My name is Lin Fan now.”

The giant red shadow was stunned for a moment before saying, “Alright. Lin Fan… Are you ready to repair the world?”

The moment he said that, Lin Fan recalled his father, mother, sister, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, and his other family members and lovers.

Then, he said seriously, “I’m ready.”

“Then receive the power!” the giant red shadow said.

A red pillar of light that was filled with pure energy flew into Lin Fan’s body.

“And mine!”

“Mine too!”

“Lin Fan, you have to repair this world!”

“I’ll leave the world to you!”

The huge shadows shouted out one after another and shot out pure energy. It all flew toward Lin Fan.

The giant black shadow that had been split into two did not speak.

However, he did not hesitate and shot out black energy.

Instantly, Lin Fan’s entire body was enveloped by all sorts of energy. The sight was multi-colored and gorgeous. It made one look up to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan’s figure grew taller and taller.

In contrast, the red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows kept shrinking.

At this moment, a loud dragon’s roar sounded in the void, shaking the surroundings.

Then, a five-colored dragon soared into the sky, emitting an endless and terrifying pressure.

The red shadow was a little tired. “Lin Fan, why didn’t you take all the energy?”

The five-colored dragon slowly condensed into the figure of Lin Fan, who was emitting a golden light. He said, “If I take any more, you won’t be able to live. My current energy is enough to repair the world.”

“But…”

The red shadow seemed to want to say something else.

“Don’t worry,” said Lin Fan.

Then, he said to Xia Xue and Xia Bing, “Do you want to go to the horizon with me?”

Xia Xue and Xia Bing nodded in unison.

In their hearts, as long as they were with Lin Fan, it was enough.

Instantly, the three of them disappeared from where they were.

In the next moment, they appeared at the edge of the Wall of the World.

The Wall of the World was the protective layer of the world and the basic condition for the formation of the world.

At this moment, countless cracks had appeared on the surface of the Wall of the World, as if it would shatter at any moment.

Once it shattered, the entire world would be instantly attacked by the chaotic astral winds. It would turn into dust.

It was a world crisis.
